findings.highlight: She only came here to push my buttons.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺をからかって遊ぶようになってきやがった
findings.governingReading: からかって遊ぶようになってき identifies a developing pattern after their actual strategy discussion; Shirou himself brought her to the roof.
findings.explanation: Rin beginning to amuse herself by teasing him becomes having come solely to tease him.
